headline: Bitcoin ETF Capital Outflows Accelerate Amid Market Pressures
summary: Capital outflows from spot Bitcoin ETFs gathered pace recently, removing a major source of institutional demand support for the cryptocurrency.
why: Spot Bitcoin ETFs provide regulated access for institutional investors, directly affecting spot market crypto liquidity and pricing.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Net capital withdrawals from exchange-traded funds reduced buying volume in the spot crypto market.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Institutional fund outflows removed liquidity support from spot digital asset markets.
